name: 5-MeO-EPT
summary: 5-MeO-EPT, also known as 5-methoxy-N-ethyl-N-propyltryptamine, is a psychedelic tryptamine derivative which has been sold as a designer drug.

uses.text: 5-MeO-EPT, also known as 5-methoxy-N-ethyl-N-propyltryptamine, is a psychedelic tryptamine derivative which has been sold as a designer drug.

pharmacology.en: Like other 5-methoxy tryptamines, it is thought to act on serotonin receptors, including the 5-HT2A receptor that classic psychedelics work on.
pharmacology.zh: 一般認為它和其他5-甲氧基色胺一樣作用於血清素受體，包括經典迷幻藥作用的5-HT2A受體。
pharmacology.zhHans: 一般认为它和其他5-甲氧基色胺一样作用于血清素受体，包括经典迷幻药作用的5-HT2A受体。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psychedelic tryptamines, can cause nausea, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的迷幻色胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的迷幻色胺类药物，可能引起恶心、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: Its nitrogen carries two different chains, one ethyl and one propyl, so unlike most tryptamines its two arms are not identical.
fact.zh: 它的氮原子上接著兩條不同的鏈，一條乙基、一條丙基，因此不像多數色胺那樣兩臂相同。
fact.zhHans: 它的氮原子上接着两条不同的链，一条乙基、一条丙基，因此不像多数色胺那样两臂相同。
